supporting_pages.title: VPN gateways \_|\_ Google Cloud VMware Engine \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: VMware Engine supports VPN connectivity by using the following types of gateways: Point-to-site VPN gateways: for point-to-site connections, like connecting from your computer to your private cloud Cloud VPN or Cloud Interconnect : for site-to-site connections, like establishing a connection between your on-premises network and your private cloud For more details about Cloud VPN and Cloud Interconnect, see Choosing a Network Connectivity product .
Point-to-site VPN gateways A point-to-site VPN gateway sends encrypted traffic between a VMware Engine network and a client computer.

VPN gateways VPN gateways provide secure connectivity between multiple sites, such as on-premises data centers, Google Cloud Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) networks, and Google Cloud VMware Engine private clouds.
